title: Remembering Allah While Waiting
paragraphs: Bilal sits in a hospital waiting room. His mother is having a small operation. He looks at the clock again and again and cannot think about anything else.
An older man sits beside him. He sees that Bilal is worried. The man says that remembering Allah helps him during a long wait.
Bilal tries it. He says simple words of remembrance quietly. He stops looking at the clock and his phone all the time.
The wait does not become shorter. But Bilal's mind feels calmer. He thinks less about the worst thing that could happen.
The doctor later brings good news. Bilal thanks the older man. He learns that remembrance can help him wait with a calmer heart.
